text:
Nadia (docs): Quick ping
 I opened a small PR to tighten Optimize docs: batching defaults, a KV-prefetch example, and a short-seq quant tip. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/531

Owen (eng): Linking. Noticed Go snippet uses NewGenCall() still. Recommend builder pattern: req := client.NewRequest().WithModel(\"redwood/opt-1\").WithBatching(true) ; resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)

Khaled: Also the embedding examples use embed_model param. New SDK uses model: "redwood/embed-1". Will push a small change.

Nadia (docs): Good catches. Can someone draft a tiny qprofile example for short prompts? We should advise fp16 for <64 tokens and 4-bit only after runbook/regression pass.

Yuri: Draft qprofile: {"name":"shortseq-fp16","dtype":"fp16","notes":"prefer fp16 for <64 tokens"}

Khaled: Perf note from infra: interactive UIs see best tail latency with batching window 20-30ms; bulk jobs 100-200ms. Suggest we add a recommended defaults section.

Nadia (docs): I'll add bullets: interactive: 20-30ms; high-throughput: 80-200ms. Also want a tiny example YAML for routing fallback when batching breaches SLOs.

Priya: YAML draft:
routing:
  policy: prefer_low_latency
  fallback:
    - model: redwood/opt-1-lite
      reason: slo_violation

DocsBot: Preview build started: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.org/531. Link check: 1 broken -> /internal/prefetch-cheatsheet

Owen (eng): The prefetch doc moved to ./prefetch/cheatsheet.md. I'll update the link to a relative path and add an anchor #examples.

Nadia (docs): Please also add 1-line note in migration guide: Generate call -> client.Generate(ctx, req) and embed_model -> model. Keep it concise.

Khaled: Ran quick harness: Go snippet compiles after change. Microbenchmark shows throughput dip when batching window >50ms; added a comment in PR recommending defaults.

DocsBot: Link check re-run: 0 broken links. Build status: green. Lint: no warnings.

Nadia (docs): Thanks all. Approving to merge once CI finalizes. Will add a one-line changelog: "Optimize: batching defaults, KV prefetch example, short-seq quant guidance, SDK migration notes."

Priya: Post-merge I'll file a follow-up to update sample apps to the new request builder API. Closing thread. :tada:
